subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): update ssrf-runtime import path in cdp-proxy-bypass

question: Should `fetchConfiguredLocalOriginWithSsrFGuard` and `registerManagedProxyBrowserCdpBypass` become public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/ssrf-runtime` API, or should this lazy-load regression be fixed while keeping those helpers private to bundled Browser/Ollama owners?
rationale: The bug is real, but choosing the permanent Plugin SDK and SSRF/proxy bypass boundary is a maintainer API/security decision rather than a mechanical import-path repair.

options.title: Preserve owner-scoped helpers
options.body: Keep the helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias or staging path, with package lazy-load proof before merge.

options.title: Approve public SDK promotion
options.body: Make the helpers public only with explicit SDK/security approval, docs/API metadata, replacement guardrails, and release-note context.

options.title: Select a canonical sibling
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers choose another sibling PR or a replacement branch as the canonical repair for the same regression.

recommendation.title: Preserve owner-scoped helpers
recommendation.body: Keep the helpers private and fix packaged Browser/Ollama resolution through the existing owner-scoped alias or staging path, with package lazy-load proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about package/Plugin SDK boundary policy, and this person has the clearest current history on the private SDK declaration hardening plus merged the relevant helper-introduction PRs.
